title: Rav Safra son of Rav Yeiva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.5a.4), speaking to Ravina. There, at [9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.9a.11), the reading is Rav Sama, but Hyman reports Rav Safra as the reading in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The first passage has Rav Safra son of Rav Yeiva speaking to Ravina about a neighboring property. The second has Rav Sama son of Rav Yeiva speaking to Rav Papa about charity. [Heilprin’s Safra entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2823&lang=en) refers readers to Sama as well. The reading Hyman reports from Dikdukei Soferim remains uncollated here.
